result.summary: PASS. Read git diff master...HEAD directly (not from BACKEND-DEV's summary). Scope: exactly apps/bot/drizzle/0007_sturdy_network.sql + meta, apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts, apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts, apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.test.ts, plus design/status/handoff bookkeeping files -- no handler file touched, no issuing/redemption logic anywhere (grep of apps/bot/src for invite_code|inviteCode|InviteCode outside schema.ts/inviteCode.ts/inviteCode.test.ts returns nothing). Migration ordering matches design/REQ-033.md exactly: CREATE TABLE invite_codes (with its own 3 FKs and UNIQUE index on code) precedes ALTER TABLE registrations ADD CONSTRAINT ... REFERENCES invite_codes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT -- read the generated SQL directly, confirmed statement order. decisions/0005: migration is drizzle-kit-generated (not hand-written -- meta/_journal.json and meta/0007_snapshot.json present) and I reviewed it as SQL line by line; it only ADDs a table and a constraint, drops/rewrites no PII column, so SECURITY-REVIEWER S13 sign-off is not triggered (matches design SS8 point 5's own read). decisions/0004: grep -i grammy on schema.ts (0 hits) and inviteCode.ts (1 hit, a comment stating 'no grammY import' -- not an actual import) confirms the domain module and schema stay framework-free; generateInviteCode() has zero I/O beyond the CSPRNG call. Generator: independently verified the byte%32 claim by computation, not by trusting the code comment -- 256 % 32 == 0, and every residue class 0..31 receives exactly 8 of the 256 possible byte values (counted directly), so the mapping is provably unbiased, not merely 'probably fine'. Alphabet constant matches design exactly: '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ', 32 chars, L and Q both present, only 0/O/1/I excluded -- verified by direct string read, not the test's own self-check. Source is node:crypto randomBytes (confirmed by reading the import), never Math.random. Independently ran: npm run lint (apps/bot) exit 0; npm run build (tsc -p tsconfig.json) exit 0; npx vitest run src/domain/inviteCode.test.ts -- 5/5 passing (length, alphabet exactness incl. L/Q inclusion and 0/O/1/I exclusion, AC7 1000-code alphabet-membership, AC6 10000-code zero-collision, CSPRNG-only runtime check).
